name: Anatomy Learning Labs: Digestive Lab
summary:
Step into the Digestive Lab of the Anatomy Learning Labs series, where the organs responsible for digestion come to life in stunning 3D. Featuring anatomically accurate models developed by medical professionals and learning activities designed by professors, the Digestive Lab teaches elementary, middle, and high school learners how food is broken down, nutrients are absorbed, and waste is eliminated.
